question: Which of the following separates Little Andaman from South Andaman of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Duncan passage.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Duncan Pass is located between South Andaman and Little Andaman.
 
• The Duncan Pass is a strait located in the Indian Ocean, it is about 48 kilometers wide.

​​​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3086437f7849d40a67cce942cd91df899858d3a6259766f5c8a5e638ae9cc365.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Andaman and Nicobar** Islands is a union territory of India.
 
• It is located in the Indian Ocean south of the Bay of Bengal.
 
• The Andaman and Nicobar Islands consist of** about 572 small islands**.
 
 
• Out of which only a few people live on the islands. Its capital is** Port Blair.​**
 
 
 
• According to the 2011 census of India, the population here is 379,944.
 
• The sex ratio is 878 females per 1,000 males.
